verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms an official Nitrokey Python SDK is published on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2). The official nitropy CLI ships alongside it as the pynitrokey package. Evidence of what the SDK covers is thin: there are no first-party SDK API docs, it supports only one language, and the low version number suggests it is still maturing. missing for 10: documented SDK API reference, multi-language SDK coverage, hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK, stability/maturity evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The official Python SDK also resolves on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2).
